text:
Ava (Marketing): flagged a pattern: several inbound leads dropped to unassigned overnight, likely HS webhook retries + enrich tail. posting sample timeline.
Rob (Sales Ops): thx. how many and timeframe? we need to know urgency before paging folks.
Ava (Marketing): 12 leads between 02:08-02:22 PT, 6 of them >120s unassigned. HubSpot webhook logs show long response times; enrichment P95 ~11s.
Lina (Growth): suggestion: set enrichment_timeout=8s, route-partial=true, and overflow_after=45s for MQLs. that reduces SLA risk.
Marco (Eng): quick note: enrichment calls hit a third-party NLU; its backoff increased when rate burst happened. short-term: client-side timeout + partial-route. long-term: add local cache for common enrichment keys.
Tara (Support): support saw 2 tickets from reps about "lead disappeared" which were actually pending claim. owner-miss is confusing. can we tag routed leads with route_status so CS can filter?
Ava (Marketing): yes. propose metadata keys: route_status, missing_enrich, routed_by, claim_attempts.
webhook-bot: HS alert: webhook POST latency spike 2026-03-21T02:10:12Z.
Rob (Sales Ops): can we push an HS webhook TTL change? shorter TTL so retry storms don't pile up. 10s TTL + 3 retries sounds reasonable.
Marco (Eng): agreed. i'll open PR to change route-service config and add partial-route flag. snippet I'll implement: 
```
routing:
  enrichment_timeout_ms: 8000
  overflow_after_ms: 45000
  partial_route: true
  hs_webhook_ttl_ms: 10000
```
Lina (Growth): for rollout: canary 5% traffic -> monitor assign latency and unassigned-count for 24h. if assign P95 < 40s and unassigned drops 90%, ramp.
Tara (Support): also add a support view: query for "route_status=partial AND missing_enrich=true" so SDRs can prioritize follow-up.
Marco (Eng): will add route_status fields and emit metric `lead_route.outcome` with tags {status,reason}.
Ava (Marketing): action items: Rob update HS webhook settings, Marco PR for routing+metrics, Lina run canary analysis, Tara add support filter and inform SDR leads. I'll schedule a 20min sync tomorrow to review canary metrics.
Rob (Sales Ops): noted. I'll change HS retries and update ops doc.
Marco (Eng): target to merge PR by EOD and deploy canary midnight PST. can someone own rollback plan?
Ava (Marketing): Ava will own rollback: revert routing flags + restore enrichment timeout prior value.
Lina (Growth): small ask: add a telemetry panel showing time-to-first-assign and percent assigned <60s by source (hubspot, sf). helps us compare.
Tara (Support): will add a dashboard card and a saved search for partial leads.
webhook-bot: ticket created: TCK-3287 for webhook latency investigation.
Ava (Marketing): thanks team. keeping this thread for PR link + canary notes. please post short status updates in the thread rather than new channels.
Marco (Eng): PR: github.com/redwood/route-service/pull/467 (will update status).
Rob (Sales Ops): HS TTL updated to 10s, retries=3. documented in ops runbook.
Lina (Growth): canary metrics 6h in: assign P50=12s P95=38s, unassigned >120s dropped 85%. looks promising. more monitoring overnight.
Tara (Support): support filter in place and routed partial leads flagged to SDR queue.
Ava (Marketing): awesome. follow up tomorrow in the 20min sync.
